linkedin:
Only 22% of remote job listings disclose pay. For brand designers in 2026, that rare data shows fixed projects from $1,500 to $5,000.

We analyzed 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar. Just 853 (22%) list a salary or rate. Among brand design roles, two fixed-price contracts stand out: Stevens pays $3,000–$5,000 per project; Sidekicks Creative Studio pays $1,500–$3,000. Meanwhile, 64% of all listings accept worldwide remote applicants.

Why does this matter? For freelancers, published rates are a benchmark. Most firms still negotiate privately, so the minority that publishes gives you leverage.

Read the full breakdown: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
